title: v0.4 Roadmap and Next Experiment
evidenceBase: FACTORY-EVAL-5 through EVAL-8: 4 phases of benchmark evaluation completed
recommendation: STOP / User Review Before Repackaging (Option D)
rationale: One benchmark (TeamFlow Lite) showed Factory Lite works but is insufficient to generalize. v0.4 packaging should not happen without user review of EVAL-9 decisions.

options.name: FACTORY-V04-PREP: Build v0.4 Resource Pack Draft
options.risk: Packaging before second benchmark may lock in untested assumptions

options.name: FACTORY-EVAL-10: Second Benchmark on Different Project
options.goal: Test if Factory Lite generalizes beyond TeamFlow Lite

options.name: FACTORY-EVAL-10: Factory Lite Robustness Stress Test
options.goal: Test Factory Lite under adverse conditions
options.risk: Stress testing may reveal gaps but is time-intensive

options.name: STOP: User Review Before Repackaging
options.action: Present EVAL-9 decisions. Wait for user to confirm: (a) agree with KEEP/CUT/DEFER, (b) choose next phase, (c) authorize v0.4 repackaging.

recommendedOrder: 3. If confirmed: FACTORY-V04-PREP (build resource pack draft)
5. After v0.4 draft: stress test or second benchmark
6. Final: v0.4 release only with user confirmation
caveats: One benchmark (TeamFlow Lite) showed Factory Lite works. This is promising but not proof of universal effectiveness.
Role-Agent underperformance may be specific to single-agent simulation. Multi-agent context was not tested.
3-role model is a hypothesis from EVAL-8 evidence, not yet benchmarked.
v0.4 should be marked as EXPERIMENTAL until second benchmark confirms.
